On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 09:34 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Initial findings from our telemetry: ClearPay's reserved pool is running at 102% ...

We rerouted ~18% of active sessions off the saturated pool at 09:45 ET to a near-identical pool (same model family, 8-bit quantized variant). That reduced token ingress but introduced a small serialization mismatch for some conversation state — we've patched the loader to normalize KV keys.

Telemetry after reroute: error rate dropped to ~3.2% and p50 is trending down but p95 still elevated (7.8s) on longer sequences. Queue depth reports show burst windows causing transient throttles. We're continuing to stream prefix-cache manifests to the pool; next step is emergency headroom.
